projects.name: Client:  – Bank of Ireland – UK - Business Analyst/Scrum Master (Jun 2019 – Mar 2025)
details: Led multiple payment and reconciliation projects involving SWIFT, RTGS, NEFT-equivalent payment
processing, and ISO 20022 message analysis.
Conducted workshops with stakeholders to gather requirements related to payment processing,
settlement, message validation, and reconciliation.
Created detailed BRD, FRD, use cases, message flow diagrams, and functional specifications.
Analyzed existing payment message formats and supported migration planning toward ISO 20022
compliant structures.
Worked extensively on SWIFT MT103, MT202, MT199 and mapped them to ISO 20022 messages.
Supported trade finance message understanding including LC and BG related message flows.
Prepared business rules and validation rules for inward and outward payments through RTGS and
NEFT channels.
Coordinated with development, QA, and infrastructure teams for message integration, API
testing, deployment, and production support.
Used   for requirement tracking, project management, reporting, and stakeholder communication.
Conducted requirement gathering sessions with business stakeholders to understand
reconciliation and payment processing needs.
Prepared BRD, FRD, process flows, and functional specifications for banking applications.
Created and maintained User Stories, acceptance criteria, and backlog items in Jira.
Worked closely with development, QA, and product teams to ensure correct implementation of
requirements.
Supported payments reconciliation processes and transaction monitoring systems.
Ensured clear communication between business stakeholders and development teams
